created_prompt: Hi.  I would like you create a three year plan to help grow a new online video blog.  The online videos focus on quick and healthy recipes for home cooks.  There is also a plan to release a cookbook, though it still up in the air whether a traditional publishing vs. self-publishing route is preferred.  The channel already has a following with 1.2 million followers.  The channel creator is also limited in resources, only being able to devote four days weekly and with a small budget.  Please create a concrete plan given these circumstances.
